_note: Delivery constraints for static creative. `evidence` says how each line is known.
api-verified  = an API rejected or accepted it in a real run; the message is quoted.
documented    = published platform guidance, not verified here. Treat as a strong prior.
Never promote `documented` to `api-verified` without a run that proves it.
Ratios are width/height. `maxTallerThan` means anything taller is centre-cropped, not letterboxed.

instagram.feed.gotcha: A 9:16 posted to feed is centre-cropped to 4:5. On a layout with a headline at top and content at bottom, that removes both. 4:5 is the tallest ratio shown intact, and is the correct answer to 'make it vertical for mobile'.

instagram.story.quote: Instagram Story will not support caption for publishing post directly
instagram.story.gotcha: Stories render no caption at all. Any text must be burned into the image. They also expire in 24h and get no algorithmic distribution beyond existing followers, so they are a reach-poor surface for evergreen creative.

instagram.reel.gotcha: Video only. Reels are pushed to non-followers, so follower geography matters far less here than on feed surfaces.

facebook.feed.gotcha: Distribution is mostly to existing followers, unlike Reels. If the follower base sits in a different timezone from the target market, this is the surface where that hurts most.

facebook.story.quote: Facebook Story will not support caption for publishing post directly

facebook.reel.gotcha: A Reel and a feed post to the same Page within a few hours split that Page's reach. Separate them by at least a day.

tiktok.quote: TikTok needs a video to create a post, it  doesn't support multi media formats
tiktok.gotcha: A static image cannot be posted at all through this path, at any ratio. Note the failure mode: creating it as a DRAFT succeeds, and only scheduling rejects it. Verify by scheduling, not by drafting.

youtube.short.gotcha: Video only. There is no static-image post type on YouTube, so a still creative simply has no home there.

linkedin.gotcha: No Stories surface since 2021. Posts carrying an outbound link in the body are down-ranked; the usual fix is link-in-first-comment, which many scheduling APIs cannot express.

google.business.gotcha: Surfaces in Maps and Search rather than a feed, so posting time barely matters. Handles video poorly; prefer a still.

recutMatrix._note: Given one source creative, the set worth producing. Fewer, correct files beat one file stretched everywhere.
